production_safety.schema_migration: None: existing tables used; no destructive migrations.

Started new live app containers alongside old apps, switched Caddy routing, tagged images and updated current symlink. No new AWS servers or paid external services provisioned.

First activation probe detected stale routing and automatically restored old routing. Confirmed a stale file inode bind mount; corrected explicit reload file and successfully passed all 13 public checks.
Oinzi public web/academy/admin screen rendering checked and screenshots saved to output/aws-live-*.png.
